segments.t: Sitting in her father's office at Arcobaleno, Katya tells Chef Barinov that German fired her over the cat incident. Barinov pretends to be outraged at German and offers Katya a job, until Senya bursts in to boast that their whiskered friend completed the mission—blowing Barinov's cover in front of his daughter.
Катя, ты будешь сейчас горячий чай?
Нет, папа, я ничего не хочу.
Я совсем не обижаюсь на тебя.
Я там больше не работаю, уволили.
Как уволили, вот же он негодяй!
Помни, ты всегда можешь работать со мной.
Шеф, наш усатый друг выполнил миссию!
Сеня, что ты несёшь, выпей чаю!
Шеф, это я про кошку говорю!
Папа, какой же ты всё-таки обманщик!
Шеф, я что, ваш сюрприз испортил?
Иди отсюда, видеть тебя не могу!
Let's examine how Chef Barinov's secret plot in the office gets exposed by Senya's loose tongue.
Катя, ты будешь сейчас горячий чай?
'Katya, will you have some hot tea right now?' Asking whether Katya has some hot tea right now cuts straight through the tension between Barinov and Katya.
Нет, папа, я ничего не хочу.

'No, Dad, I do not want anything.' Katya mentions that dad she does not want anything so Barinov sees what is at stake. Russian stacks "never" or "nothing" together with "not", doubling the refusal for extra weight.
Я совсем не обижаюсь на тебя.

'I am not offended at you at all.' Since he is not offended at Katya at all, Barinov does not waste words on excuses. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Я там больше не работаю, уволили.
'I do not work there anymore, they fired me.' Explaining that she does not work there anymore they fired lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
Как уволили, вот же он негодяй!

'What do you mean fired, what a scoundrel he is!' Declaring that what do Katya means fired what a scoundrel he is brings Barinov's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Помни, ты всегда можешь работать со мной.

'Remember, you can always work with me.' Explaining that Katya should remember Katya can always work with him lays the cards on the table for Katya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Шеф, наш усатый друг выполнил миссию!
'Chef, our whiskered friend completed the mission!' Between the work and the friend, Senya delivers a sharp reaction.
Сеня, что ты несёшь, выпей чаю!

'Senya, what nonsense are you talking, drink some tea!' Barinov declares that what nonsense are Katya talking drink some tea as the tension in the room peaks. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Шеф, это я про кошку говорю!
'Chef, I am talking about the cat!' Insisting that he is talking about the cat shows Senya is not backing down. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Папа, какой же ты всё-таки обманщик!
'Dad, what a deceiver you really are!' Insisting that dad what a deceiver Barinov really are shows Katya is not backing down.
Шеф, я что, ваш сюрприз испортил?

'Chef, did I ruin your surprise or what?' Here checking whether he ruins Barinov's surprise shows Senya looking for the real truth. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Иди отсюда, видеть тебя не могу!

'Get out of here, I cannot stand the sight of you!' By getting out of here he cannot stand the sight of Katya, Barinov raises the stakes in the room at once. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them. Now listen to the entire exposure scene again without interruption.

Папа, какой же ты всё-таки обманщик!
Шеф, я что, ваш сюрприз испортил?
Иди отсюда, видеть тебя не могу!

Furious at her father's betrayal, Katya storms out while Ainura tallies up eighteen broken plates from the ruined banquet. Next, a guilty Chef Barinov goes to Claude Monet to confess. See you next time!
Пока!
